about: The server's definition of a change-appearance session, replicated to the client: Definition (the character as a full respec definition), Appearance (Name, BodyType, BodyShape, RootTemplate, Voice, Identity and the look Visual), Version, Synced and Character, the character being edited. Script Extender: CCChangeAppearanceDefinition.

evidence.says: Script Extender's header Components/CharacterCreation.h binds CCChangeAppearanceDefinition to this engine name; the offsets of Version, Synced and Character are the ones its legacy field names carry, and Appearance (ChangeAppearanceDefinitionBase) lies between Definition and Version

in a change-appearance session (Osi.StartChangeAppearance on the host of a running level) one entity carries it together with CCDefinitionCommon, on the server and replicated on the client; Version reads 1, Synced true, Character the host's entity; Appearance reads the host's name, body type 0, his voice id, Identity 3, a RootTemplate other than his own template and a Visual with real colour ids and an accessory set
